description_en: Invokes the DeleteTrafficMirrorFilter operation to delete a traffic mirror filter
description_zh: 调用DeleteTrafficMirrorFilter接口删除流量镜像筛选条件
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-traffic-mirror-filter --traffic-mirror-filter-id tmf-j6cmls82xnc86vtpe0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteTrafficMirrorFilter

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the traffic mirror filter
parameters.help_zh: 流量镜像筛选条件的实例ID
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_filter_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: sends a check request without deleting the traffic mirror filter. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, the traffic mirror filter is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会删除流量镜像筛选条件。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式和限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接删除流量镜像筛选条件
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the traffic mirror. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the most recent region list. For more information about regions that support traffic mirroring, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207513.html
parameters.help_zh: 流量镜像的所属地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。关于流量镜像支持的地域，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207513.html
parameters.name: region_id
